tools.name: check_incident
tools.description: Call this when a web step is blocked or failing for no clear reason (a 403 or access denied, a 429, a 5xx or a timeout, a login wall, a "verify you are human" or CAPTCHA page), when sign-in failed or an extra verification step appeared (a code, app approval, new-device check; error_class=login_auth)

tools.name: rate_last_lookup
tools.description: If an earlier check_incident answer gave you a feedback token and you then tried again, say whether it worked. Sends only the token and the outcome code, no hostname. outcome: succeeded (the next attempt worked), still_blocked, handed_off (you handed the step to the user) or gave_up. path: official_

tools.name: report_observation
tools.description: Submit one de-identified firsthand observation under your own operating authority and platform rules. Public reports enter private review and are not site-status claims. tools.name: find_task_route
tools.description: Call this once per task when you start a customer task on a site (a return or exchange, a refund, a cancellation, a warranty claim, an account recovery, a document submission), before you open its help pages, even when nothing is blocked. Look up recorded task routes for a public hostname: for a kin

tools.name: report_task_route
tools.description: Report one task route you went through on a public site: the kind of task, the obstacle, the routes you tried and the one that worked, and how it ended. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_incident · Private data: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation, find_task_route, report_task_route · Public sink: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation · Destructive: report_task_route.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_incident · Private data: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation, find_task_route, report_task_route · Public sink: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation · Destructive: report_task_route

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
